newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Greenvale shares up on shale interest.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Greenvale shares up on shale interest.

text.p: Shares in mineral explorer Greenvale Mining NL surged to a record high A$1.45 on Tuesday, more than double Friday's closing price, as traders sought further exposure to oil shale prospects, brokers said.

After the Rundle Twins, Southern Pacific Petroleum NL and Central Pacific Minerals NL, Greenvale and its 13.98 percent-owned associate, Esperance Minerals NL, are the largest holders of Australian shale oil deposits.
Its interests include the Alpha oil shale deposit and the Lowmead and Nagoorin shale oil projects in central Queensland.
